impact: While levelling a saved Unchained Rogue 5 -> 20 through the real in-app Level up modal, the sheet's in-memory chosen class levels acquired a stray CharacterClassLevel { class_id: "class:fighter", level: 1 } beside the unchained_rogue level. The engine then reported 'base class chassis is only supported for a single-class class:fighter at levels 1-20 or a single-class class:wizard at levels 1-20 ... so no chassis values were computed' in a red banner and stopped computing total saves. The persisted authoritative_character_input.txt never contained the fighter level, and closing and re-loading the character cleared the banner entirely
resolution: close the sheet and load the character again from disk
summary: Repeated in-app level-ups left a phantom class:fighter level 1 in the sheet's live state, degrading the computed sheet until reload; persisted state was correct.
